research_decision.operation: reselect current research thesis and publication architecture after full-universe requirement expansion and 2026 policy refresh
research_decision.objective: produce a falsifiable full-universe A-share cross-border-ecommerce research thesis that distinguishes structural de-minimis tightening, tariff-phase easing, company profit transmission, and market-role recognition without converting the public article into investment advice

evidence.summary: 2026H1 China cross-border e-commerce imports+exports RMB1.45tn, +5.8%; exports RMB1.16tn, +6.3%; the sector remains growing rather than collapsing.
EO 14389 ended the listed IEEPA additional ad-valorem tariffs on Feb 20, 2026 while explicitly leaving the separate de-minimis suspension and Section 122 surcharge unaffected.
CBP indefinitely suspended the $800 de-minimis exemption for international mail and established a new postal informal-entry process effective July 24, 2026.
CBP indefinitely suspended de-minimis for non-postal modes, requiring formal or informal entry procedures.

China and the U.S. agreed a roughly USD30bn-each tariff-reduction framework, but preferential treatment remains conditional on each side's domestic law and procedures; it is a pending easing scenario, not an effective tariff rate.
USTR describes the USD30bn lists as recommendations for future more favorable treatment, confirming pending rather than effective status.
EU temporary EUR3 customs duty applies from July 1, 2026 per tariff category/item in low-value consignments; product identifiers become mandatory Nov 1, 2026.
EU reform makes non-EU platforms importer-responsible and requires an EU-wide small-parcel handling fee by Nov 1, 2026; fee level remains to be set by the Commission.
GACC Announcement 2026 No.24 nationally expands cross-customs-district returns for 9610 retail exports from Apr 1, lowering domestic return friction.
Task research covers 174 A-share names and classifies them by economic role, purity, financial realization and weak-tag status.
Current close-based market-role study separates business strength, concept recognition, current board position, stock character and capacity/trend role.
User explicitly requires the Deep version to carry the complete retained A-share universe with subsegment comparison rather than silently omit non-core names.
Overseas-warehouse exposure does not mechanically produce company-wide profit; utilization, tail-mile, FX and capex still govern conversion.
High concept-name recognition can coexist with lower export-small-parcel economic purity because current revenue mix is import-heavy.

learned_items: 2026 cross-border e-commerce is not a one-way tightening story: structural de-minimis/compliance tightening coexists with terminated IEEPA surcharges and a pending bilateral tariff-easing framework.
The correct comparison unit is profit-transmission mechanism and realization stage, not concept membership.
Full-universe publication can satisfy completeness without becoming 174 isolated mini-profiles by grouping weak/incidental names and expanding only decision-changing comparisons.
Business strength, durability, short-horizon concept recognition, current board height and capacity/trend confirmation are separate judgments.
assumptions_challenged: de-minimis removal means all 2025 IEEPA tariff rates still apply in late 2026
cross-border e-commerce regulation tightening implies sector-wide contraction
the company with the strongest business fundamentals must also be the short-line leader
full-universe publication requires equal-length company profiles
a concept software tag is sufficient evidence of profit exposure

alternatives.mechanism: publish the 174-name pool primarily as a sector directory, with each company receiving roughly similar treatment
advantages: easy for readers to verify that no retained name disappeared
failure_modes: article becomes a stock encyclopedia rather than finance analysis
fit_conditions: user asks for a reference handbook or database export
misfit_conditions: current task requires a readable Deep finance article plus subsegment comparison

alternatives.mechanism: treat U.S./EU low-value parcel rules as a one-way tightening shock and rank perceived beneficiary branches such as brands, B2B and warehouses
failure_modes: stale after termination of IEEPA additional tariffs
turns relative demand migration into automatic profit benefit
fit_conditions: all material policy phases point in the same tightening direction and company conversion evidence is broad
misfit_conditions: current 2026 evidence contains both structural tightening and tariff-phase easing

alternatives.mechanism: center the public article on which A-share names have the best board position, recognition and limit-up elasticity
advantages: connects policy with current price discovery
failure_modes: confuses private research with public finance output
market role may be driven by unrelated themes
fit_conditions: user explicitly requests a compliant non-actionable market-structure note
misfit_conditions: current task is a full finance content portfolio where short-horizon roles are private analytical inputs

alternatives.mechanism: use the complete 174-name universe, but organize it by profit-transmission mechanism under two simultaneous forces: structural low-value-parcel/compliance tightening and stage-specific tariff/policy easing; compare within segments, then select cross-segment business/market roles without collapsing them into one winner
advantages: keeps market-role evidence analytical rather than prescriptive
failure_modes: can still become bloated if weak names are expanded instead of clustered
requires strict separation of current facts, pending policy and company-specific confounders
fit_conditions: the universe is broad, policy forces are bidirectional, and company outcomes diverge by business model
misfit_conditions: evidence later shows one universal policy shock and one dominant transmission path across most companies

counterexamples: 2026H1 sector trade value grew 5.8%, so tighter low-value-parcel rules do not imply sector collapse.
The U.S. ended IEEPA additional ad-valorem tariffs in February while keeping de-minimis suspension, so 'all tightening' is factually wrong.
Loctek shows warehouse demand/localization does not guarantee profit conversion.
Cross-border Tong has very high theme recognition but its current import-heavy mix prevents treating name recognition as export-policy profit purity.
Oriental Jiasheng and Ogawa/OGAWA recent limit-ups are driven materially by other themes, so price strength cannot be attributed to cross-border e-commerce without branch co-movement.
rejected_paths: carry forward the old selective Deep and merely append an appendix of omitted companies
fast-forward later Word files to DELIVERY without re-admitting research
rank all 174 companies on one scalar score
publish private board-height/limit-up scoring as actionable stock advice
treat the pending 30-for-30 framework or unset EU handling-fee amount as already effective facts
research_decision.selection_rationale: It is the only candidate that simultaneously matches the user's complete-universe requirement, the refreshed 2026 policy chronology, company-level financial divergence and the separation between business quality and market recognition. It preserves all 174 names without assigning equal analytical weight, and it remains falsifiable if tariff implementation, EU fee settings or H2 company evidence change.

sweeps.query_or_scope: recover and classify complete A-share concept/economic universe
refresh U.S./EU/China 2026 policy chronology and effective-status ledger
new_counterexamples: IEEPA additional tariffs ended while de-minimis suspension persisted

sweeps.query_or_scope: challenge branch winners and short-horizon role assumptions across sellers B2B warehouse payment and theme-recognition names
current-close market structure and role-map stability check after policy refresh
official-source status check for pending 30-for-30 implementation EU November fee/PID and U.S. post-July de-minimis process

saturation.stop_reason: After the full-universe expansion and policy-status correction changed the thesis, two materially different final sweeps—current-close market structure and official policy-status verification—added no decision-changing candidate, failure mode, counterexample or thesis change.

verification_plan: Research Audit must verify all 174 retained names are accounted for by economic segment and no material branch is silently omitted.
Every policy statement in publication must label status as effective, expired/terminated, pending implementation, or future/unset; no superseded tariff phase may be written as current.
Deep must visibly carry the full retained universe while expanding only decision-changing companies and grouping weak/incidental names with explicit reasons.
Core comparisons must distinguish business directness, purity, financial realization, durability and reversal condition; no one-dimensional beneficiary ranking.
Private short-horizon market roles may guide editorial emphasis but publication must remain non-actionable and must not expose buy/sell/timing/position instructions.
Re-run source-compared originality and all eight PublicationFitness gates after the rebuilt Deep/Broad drafts.
remaining_unknowns: The EU-wide handling-fee amount has not yet been set by the Commission as of the research freeze; the known fact is its pending status, not a missing discoverable number.
The 30-for-30 tariff recommendations have not yet completed domestic implementation as of the research freeze; actual effective dates and final tariff treatment remain future scenario triggers.
Company-level 2026H2 filings are not yet available for all names, so causal attribution between policy and business execution must remain bounded by current H1/available disclosures.

company_universe_and_value_chain.summary: 完整研究池为东方财富BK1115广义跨境电商170只，加拉卡拉、新国都、海联金汇、米奥会展4只经济链补充，共174只；按核心卖家/品牌、直接跨境制造品牌、传统OEM/ODM出口、B2B贸易服务、海外仓/物流、营销获客、SaaS/自动化、支付/FX、进口/零售、供应链辅助与弱标签分层。Deep必须承载完整保留池，但允许对弱相关公司紧凑分组并明确弱化理由。

business_granularity.summary: 不把“海外收入”“有电商”“公司名像概念”视为同一暴露。公司按利润来源和事件传导拆到平台卖家/品牌渠道/OEM-ODM/B2B/履约仓配/支付/营销/SaaS等业务颗粒，并区分真实收入兑现、渠道试水、间接辅助与纯概念标签。

market_cap_and_liquidity.summary: 短线角色只在重要候选中结合总市值/流通盘、换手、成交额、近期涨停记忆和当前身位；不将基本面最强自动等同涨停核心。主板10cm与北交所标的分开处理。

catalyst_strength_and_freshness.summary: 截至2026-10-16，真正改变利润模型的催化不是单一“加税”：美国低值免税退出是结构性收紧，但2026-02-20已结束IEEPA额外从价税；CBP 6/24规则把de minimis长期暂停转入自身法规并在7/24启用邮政非正式报关；欧盟7/1起€3临时关税生效、11/1 PID与独立handling fee进入下一阶段；9月中美300亿对300亿是待国内程序实施的潜在缓和；中国4/1起全国推广9610跨关区退货便利化。

benefit_chain_tiering.summary: 受损/受益必须按机制分层：低客单直邮B2C最直接承受低值免税退出与申报合规成本；品牌/高毛利产品有更强成本吸收与提价空间；B2B获客、合规服务、本地履约/海外仓、支付结算可承接迁移需求但不是自动受益；传统OEM/ODM更多受终端订单、关税、汇率和客户库存影响；进口零售属于另一侧链条。

short_horizon_role_map.summary: 2026-10-16收盘尚无独立跨境电商主线。若出现泛跨境强催化，跨境通是主板题材辨识度/先锋观察；B2B专项看焦点科技；海外仓专项看嘉诚国际；东方嘉盛现有身位需跨境/物流同支线共振才可重映射；奥佳华、返利科技等更多是股性/叠加题材载体；安克、绿联、焦点、小商品城更偏容量/趋势或产业确认。

market_structure_and_positioning.summary: 10/16市场处于高位股集中、低位淘汰较重的环境；跨境标签股有个别涨停/连板但主驱动多来自半导体、机器人、消费/AI等其他叙事，不能把共享标签的上涨机械认定为跨境电商板块发酵。

counterfactual_company_comparison.summary: 同分支比较保留反事实：安克/绿联/致欧/吉宏/赛维的跨境经营质量高于大量标签股，但短线弹性未必最高；焦点科技对B2C转B2B的传导更直接，国联股份/生意宝跨境纯度更弱；嘉诚国际海外仓纯度与弹性较高，乐歌则用“需求增长不等于利润增长”构成反例；拉卡拉当前跨境支付规模兑现强于新国都，但支付不是低值小包规则的唯一利润转移方向。

negative_and_falsification_pool.summary: 核心反例包括：行业规模增长否定“监管收紧=行业坍塌”；赛维Amazon增长/Temu下降否定“所有平台同向”；乐歌海外仓收入与利润转换不自动同步否定“海外仓必受益”；跨境通进口业务占比高否定“名称辨识度=出口小包利润纯度”；东方嘉盛/奥佳华现有涨停主因并非纯跨境否定“标签股涨停=板块主线”。

scenario_tree.summary: 情景A：美欧低值小包合规/税费继续收紧且9月中美降税框架未落地，优先观察品牌化/B2B/本地履约/支付合规替代；情景B：300亿对300亿按公布清单落地，家电/玩具/厨卫等部分中国商品对美税负边际缓和，品牌与制造出口分支相对改善但de minimis并不恢复；情景C：欧盟11/1 handling fee/PID执行强，低价直邮压力加大；情景D：跨境电商并未形成市场主线，则短线角色不从业务逻辑强行推导。

next_window_validation.summary: 后续验证点：中美300亿对300亿是否完成各自国内程序及具体生效税目/日期；欧委会在11/1前确定handling fee金额；10/22后美国邮政数据合规节点及后续电子化规则；2026H2公司公告验证品牌/渠道/B2B/海外仓/支付的收入、毛利、利用率、续费与现金流转换；市场端仅在跨境分支共振后确认短线总龙头。

publication_distillation.summary: Deep必须满足用户的全174保留池可见要求，但不写174段迷你公司档案；结构应按利润模型/政策传导分组，核心公司做强弱比较，弱标签集中列名并解释为何弱。Broad独立重建，只提炼“低值免税退出与税率阶段缓和并存→利润取决于成本转嫁/模式迁移能力”的读者主线，不暴露私人短线角色工作流。

material_catalyst_and_policy_ledger.summary: 政策账本按时间和状态区分：美国2025全球de minimis暂停为背景；2026-02-20终止IEEPA额外从价税但不恢复de minimis，Section122 10%仅为150天临时措施；2026-06-24 CBP用自身法规无限期暂停低值免税，7/24启用邮政非正式报关并按适用税则征税；欧盟7/1起€3临时关税生效，11/1 PID强制且独立handling fee最晚同日落地、金额待欧委会设定；中国4/1起9610跨关区退货全国推广；9月中美300亿对300亿仅为待国内程序实施的未来优惠框架。任何后续文章不得把已终止税率、未生效框架或未确定fee金额写成现行事实。

driver_sustainability_operability_and_co.summary: 驱动分成制度型（de minimis退出、EU customs reform，持续性高）、阶段税率型（Section122已到期/被后续流程替代，300亿框架待落地）、运营型（品牌/渠道/B2B/海外仓/支付/合规，需财务兑现）、情绪型（概念辨识度/涨停记忆，持续性取决于市场共振）。经济概念与市场标签分池：业务龙头、题材辨识度龙头、当前身位、股性、容量趋势核心不能混成一个“龙头”。

cross_segment_global_selection.summary: 跨分支总决选不设单一股票冠军：业务质量/持续性层优先观察安克、绿联、致欧、吉宏、赛维等品牌/卖家；政策传导最直接的B2B样本为焦点科技；海外仓纯度/弹性样本嘉诚国际、反例乐歌；跨境支付兑现最清晰为拉卡拉；市场题材辨识度/潜在情绪先锋为跨境通，但其基本面出口纯度与标签纯度不一致。Deep应解释这些“不同维度的强”如何同时成立，而非把内部短线评分公开成荐股表。
